# Trident Structures

> Trident Structures LLC is an industrial Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firm and portfolio company of Junction Industries, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. Trident Structures specializes in dry bulk material handling systems, concrete batch plants, bulk storage silos, rail transload terminals, micro-mining processing plants, and high-density automated parking systems.

## Corporate Overview
- **Legal Entity:** Trident Structures LLC
- **Parent Company:** Junction Industries, LLC (https://www.jct-ind.com/)
- **Corporate Office:** 3348 Peden Road, Suite 700, Fort Worth, TX 76179
- **Phone:** (817) 607-8373
- **Email:** sales@trident-structures.com
- **Website:** https://www.trident-structures.com

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Dry Bulk Material Handling:** Complete turnkey design and construction of conveyor systems, bucket elevators, screw conveyors, pneumatic blowers, and truck/rail loadout terminals.
- **Concrete Batch Plants:** Custom-engineered dry and wet mix concrete batch plants, aggregate bins, batchers, and automated control systems.
- **Storage Silos & Terminals:** Welded and bolted steel silos for cement, fly ash, lime, grain, frac sand, and industrial minerals.
- **Rail Transloading Facilities:** Rail spur engineering, bottom-dump rail car unloading pits, track scale integration, and high-speed transload loops.
- **Automated & Mechanical Parking:** High-density puzzle, rotary, and automated vehicle storage systems for commercial real estate developments.
- **Micro-Mining & Processing:** Modular crushing, screening, and dry separation equipment for mining operations.

## Industry Memberships & Safety Certifications
